# BuildQuote

> BuildQuote (buildquote.com.au) publishes manufacturer-verified Australian
> construction product data. Every System Card in the /library has a
> machine-readable sibling — a knowledge object with typed facts, evidence
> (source document, page, verbatim quote) and manufacturer verification
> status on each one. Facts an AI cannot verify are declared as unknown
> rather than inferred.

## Knowledge layer

- [Card catalogue](https://studio.buildquote.com.au/api/knowledge/index.jsonld): every published system, with its knowledge-object URL
- [Vocabulary](https://studio.buildquote.com.au/ns/v1): the bq: JSON-LD terms used across every object
- [Format manifest](https://studio.buildquote.com.au/api/knowledge/manifest.json): endpoints, status semantics, licence

Per-system objects are available two ways:
- `https://buildquote.com.au/api/library/{manufacturer}/{system}/knowledge.jsonld` (mirrored, cached)
- `https://studio.buildquote.com.au/api/cards/{system}/knowledge.jsonld?m={manufacturer}` (canonical)

Public, no key required. Every fact carries an epistemicStatus — only
`manufacturer_verified` and `manufacturer_corrected` represent a
manufacturer statement; treat anything else as an unreviewed extraction.
